title: [BUG] `/bug` does not report bug, 🤣
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [*] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.21
- Operating System: macos15.5
- Terminal:  Terminal App

## Bug Description
you said "We welcome your feedback. Use the /bug command to report issues directly within Claude Code" at README.md in this repo. But when i use `/bug`, claude say: "I'll help you identify and fix bugs in the codebase."

## Steps to Reproduce
1. `claude`
2. `/bug`


## Expected Behavior
report issues

## Actual Behavior
claude started to  find bugs in my project
